verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ֭אֵלֶּה מֵעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת־ אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּעֵינָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·bə·ṯū šə·lō·šeṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh mê·‘ă·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ kî hū ṣad·dîq bə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: So these three men stopped answering Job because he was righteous in his own eyes
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO aqueles três homens cessaram de responder a Jó; porque era justo aos seus próprios olhos.

verses.original: וַיִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף׀ אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן־ בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַבּוּזִי֮ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֪חַ֫ת רָ֥ם בְּ֭אִיּוֹב חָרָ֣ה אַפּ֑וֹ עַֽל־ צַדְּק֥וֹ נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ מֵאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar ’ap̄ ’ĕ·lî·hū ḇen- ba·raḵ·’êl hab·bū·zî mim·miš·pa·ḥaṯ rām bə·’î·yō·wḇ ḥā·rāh ’ap·pōw ‘al- ṣad·də·qōw nap̄·šōw mê·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: This kindled the anger of Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite of the family of Ram He burned with anger against Job for justifying himself rather than God
verses.literalPt: E acendeu-se a ira de Eliú, filho de Baraquel, o buzita, da família de Rão; contra Jó se acendeu a sua ira, porque se justificava a si mesmo, mais do que a Deus.

verses.original: וּבִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָיו֮ חָרָ֪ה אַ֫פּ֥וֹ עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת־ אִיּֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇiš·lō·šeṯ rê·‘āw ḥā·rāh ’ap·pōw ‘al ’ă·šer lō- mā·ṣə·’ū ma·‘ă·neh way·yar·šî·‘ū ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ
verses.literal: and he burned with anger against Job’s three friends because they had failed . . . to refute Job and yet had condemned him
verses.literalPt: Também a sua ira se acendeu contra os seus três amigos, porque, não achando que responder, todavia condenavam a Jó.

verses.original: וֶֽאֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת־ אִ֭יּוֹב בִּדְבָרִ֑ים כִּ֤י זְֽקֵנִים־ הֵ֖מָּה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ לְיָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·hū ḥik·kāh ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ biḏ·ḇā·rîm kî zə·qê·nîm- hêm·māh mim·men·nū lə·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job because the others were older than he
verses.literalPt: Eliú, porém, esperou para falar a Jó, porquanto tinham mais idade do que ele.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלִיה֗וּא כִּ֘י אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭פִי שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיִּ֥חַר אַפּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ĕ·lî·hū kî ’ên ma·‘ă·neh bə·p̄î šə·lō·šeṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm way·yi·ḥar ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: But when he saw that the three men had no further reply . . . his anger was kindled
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, Eliú que já não havia resposta na boca daqueles três homens, a sua ira se acendeu.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַן׀ אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן־ בַּֽרַכְאֵ֥ל הַבּוּזִ֗י וַיֹּ֫אמַ֥ר צָ֘עִ֤יר אֲנִ֣י לְ֭יָמִים וְאַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל־ כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָֽאִירָ֓א׀ מֵחַוֺּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’ĕ·lî·hū ḇen- ba·raḵ·’êl hab·bū·zî way·yō·mar ṣā·‘îr ’ă·nî lə·yā·mîm wə·’at·tem yə·šî·šîm ‘al- kên zā·ḥal·tî wå̄·ʾī·rå̄ mê·ḥaw·wōṯ dê·‘î ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: So Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite . . . declared I am young in years while you are old that is why . . . I was timid and afraid to tell you what I know
verses.literalPt: E respondeu Eliú, filho de Baraquel, o buzita, dizendo: Eu sou de menos idade, e vós sois idosos; receei-me e temi de vos declarar a minha opinião.

verses.original: אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar·tî yā·mîm yə·ḏab·bê·rū wə·rōḇ šā·nîm yō·ḏî·‘ū ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: I thought that age should speak and many years should teach wisdom
verses.literalPt: Dizia eu: Falem os dias, e a multidão dos anos ensine a sabedoria.

verses.original: אָ֭כֵן רֽוּחַ־ הִ֣יא בֶאֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵên rū·aḥ- hî ḇe·’ĕ·nō·wōš wə·niš·maṯ šad·day tə·ḇî·nêm
verses.literal: But there is a spirit in a man the breath of the Almighty that gives him understanding
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, há um espírito no homem, e a inspiração do Todo-Poderoso o faz entendido.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ רַבִּ֥ים יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ וּ֝זְקֵנִ֗ים יָבִ֥ינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: lō- rab·bîm yeḥ·kā·mū ū·zə·qê·nîm yā·ḇî·nū miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: It is not only the old who are wise or the elderly who understand justice
verses.literalPt: Os grandes não são os sábios, nem os velhos entendem o que é direito.

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־ לִּ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵּעִ֣י אַף־ אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ā·mar·tî šim·‘āh- lî ’ă·ḥaw·weh dê·‘î ’ap̄- ’ā·nî
verses.literal: Therefore I say Listen to me I too will declare what I know
verses.literalPt: Assim digo: Dai-me ouvidos, e também eu declararei a minha opinião.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן הוֹחַ֨לְתִּי לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד־ תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם עַֽד־ תַּחְקְר֥וּן מִלִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: hên hō·w·ḥal·tî lə·ḏiḇ·rê·ḵem ’ā·zîn ‘aḏ- tə·ḇū·nō·ṯê·ḵem ‘aḏ- taḥ·qə·rūn mil·lîn
verses.literal: Indeed I waited while you spoke I listened to your reasoning as you searched for words
verses.literalPt: Eis que aguardei as vossas palavras, e dei ouvidos às vossas considerações, até que buscásseis razões.

verses.original: וְעָֽדֵיכֶ֗ם אֶתְבּ֫וֹנָ֥ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵ֣ין לְאִיּ֣וֹב מוֹכִ֑יחַ עוֹנֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣יו מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḏê·ḵem ’eṯ·bō·w·nān wə·hin·nêh ’ên lə·’î·yō·wḇ mō·w·ḵî·aḥ ‘ō·w·neh ’ă·mā·rāw mik·kem
verses.literal: I paid you full attention . . . . . . But no one proved Job wrong not one of you rebutted his arguments
verses.literalPt: Atentando, pois, para vós, eis que nenhum de vós há que possa convencer a Jó, nem que responda às suas razões;

verses.original: פֶּן־ תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חָכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל יִדְּפֶ֣נּוּ לֹא־ אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: pen- tō·mə·rū mā·ṣā·nū ḥāḵ·māh ’êl yid·də·p̄en·nū lō- ’îš
verses.literal: So do not claim We have found wisdom let God not man refute him
verses.literalPt: Para que não digais: Achamos a sabedoria; Deus o derrubou, e não homem algum.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ עָרַ֣ךְ אֵלַ֣י מִלִּ֑ין וּ֝בְאִמְרֵיכֶ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ‘ā·raḵ ’ê·lay mil·lîn ū·ḇə·’im·rê·ḵem lō ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū
verses.literal: But Job has not directed his words against me and I will not answer him with your arguments
verses.literalPt: Ora ele não dirigiu contra mim palavra alguma, nem lhe responderei com as vossas palavras.

verses.original: חַ֭תּוּ לֹא־ עָ֣נוּ ע֑וֹד הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵהֶ֣ם מִלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḥat·tū lō- ‘ā·nū ‘ō·wḏ he‘·tî·qū mê·hem mil·lîm
verses.literal: Job’s friends are dismayed with no more to say words have escaped them
verses.literalPt: Estão pasmados, não respondem mais, faltam-lhes as palavras.

verses.original: וְ֭הוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי־ לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא־ עָ֥נוּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ḥal·tî kî- lō yə·ḏab·bê·rū kî ‘ā·mə·ḏū lō- ‘ā·nū ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Must I wait now that they are silent . . . now that they stand and no longer reply
verses.literalPt: Esperei, pois, mas não falam; porque já pararam, e não respondem mais.

verses.original: אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף־ אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף־ אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·‘ă·neh ’ap̄- ’ă·nî ḥel·qî ’ă·ḥaw·weh ḏê·‘î ’ap̄- ’ā·nî
verses.literal: I . . . too will answer yes I will declare what I know
verses.literalPt: Também eu responderei pela minha parte; também eu declararei a minha opinião.

verses.original: כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְנִי ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî mā·lê·ṯî mil·lîm hĕ·ṣî·qaṯ·nî rū·aḥ biṭ·nî
verses.literal: For I am full of words and my spirit within me compels me
verses.literalPt: Porque estou cheio de palavras; o meu espírito me constrange.

verses.original: הִנֵּֽה־ בִטְנִ֗י כְּיַ֥יִן לֹא־ יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּאֹב֥וֹת חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים יִבָּקֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- ḇiṭ·nî kə·ya·yin lō- yip·pā·ṯê·aḥ kə·’ō·ḇō·wṯ ḥă·ḏā·šîm yib·bā·qê·a‘
verses.literal: Behold my belly is like unvented wine it is about to burst like a new wineskin
verses.literalPt: Eis que dentro de mim sou como o mosto, sem respiradouro, prestes a arrebentar, como odres novos.

verses.original: אֲדַבְּרָ֥ה וְיִֽרְוַֽח־ לִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתַ֣י וְאֶֽעֱנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh wə·yir·waḥ- lî ’ep̄·taḥ śə·p̄ā·ṯay wə·’e·‘ĕ·neh
verses.literal: I must speak and find relief I must open my lips and respond
verses.literalPt: Falarei, para que ache alívio; abrirei os meus lábios, e responderei.

verses.original: אַל־ נָ֭א אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־ אִ֑ישׁ וְאֶל־ אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- nā ’eś·śā p̄ə·nê- ’îš wə·’el- ’ā·ḏām lō ’ă·ḵan·neh
verses.literal: I will be partial . . . to no . . . one . . . nor will I flatter any man
verses.literalPt: Que não faça eu acepção de pessoas, nem use de palavras lisonjeiras com o homem!

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט יִשָּׂאֵ֥נִי עֹשֵֽׂנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō yā·ḏa‘·tî ’ă·ḵan·neh kim·‘aṭ yiś·śā·’ê·nî ‘ō·śê·nî
verses.literal: For I do not know how to flatter or my Maker would remove me in an instant
verses.literalPt: Porque não sei usar de lisonjas; em breve me levaria o meu Criador.
